title_en: Oh Love, Young I Fell Ill
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; sounds like a modern pop-folk song, no author I can name. 'Мојата љубов ти ја заб'рави' is my reading: 'you forgot my love'.

lines.cyr: Прстен ти враќам, мило либе,
lines.lat: Prsten ti vraḱam, milo libe,
lines.en: I am returning your ring, dear love,

lines.cyr: и сè што имам од тебе.
lines.lat: i sè što imam od tebe.
lines.en: and everything I have from you.

lines.cyr: Спомен од тебе нејќум да имам,
lines.lat: Spomen od tebe nejḱum da imam,
lines.en: I do not want any keepsake of you,

lines.cyr: сакам да те заборавам.
lines.lat: sakam da te zaboravam.
lines.en: I want to forget you.

lines.cyr: Оф либе ле, срцето ми го изгоре,
lines.lat: Of libe le, srceto mi go izgore,
lines.en: Oh love, my heart you burned,

lines.cyr: оф либе ле, мене ме млада разболе.
lines.lat: of libe le, mene me mlada razbole.
lines.en: oh love, young as I am you made me ill.

lines.cyr: Не можам либе да ти простам,
lines.lat: Ne možam libe da ti prostam,
lines.en: I cannot forgive you, love,

lines.cyr: ни да ти заборавам,
lines.lat: ni da ti zaboravam,
lines.en: nor forget you,

lines.cyr: мојата љубов ти ја заб'рави,
lines.lat: mojata ljubov ti ja zab'ravi,
lines.en: my love you forgot,

lines.cyr: на друга ти ја подари.
lines.lat: na druga ti ja podari.
lines.en: and gave it to another.

lines.cyr: Мене ме судба проколна, либе,
lines.lat: Mene me sudba prokolna, libe,
lines.en: Fate cursed me, love,

lines.cyr: цел живот млада да плачам.
lines.lat: cel život mlada da plačam.
lines.en: to cry all my life, young as I am.

lines.cyr: Оф либе ле, срцето ми го изгоре,
lines.lat: Of libe le, srceto mi go izgore,
lines.en: Oh love, my heart you burned,

lines.cyr: оф либе ле, мене ме млада разболе.
lines.lat: of libe le, mene me mlada razbole.
lines.en: oh love, young as I am you made me ill.

lines.cyr: Мојата младост помина, либе,
lines.lat: Mojata mladost pomina, libe,
lines.en: My youth has passed, love,

lines.cyr: без љубов и без топлина.
lines.lat: bez ljubov i bez toplina.
lines.en: without love and without warmth.

lines.cyr: Знај дека либе и ти ќе жалиш
lines.lat: Znaj deka libe i ti ḱe žališ
lines.en: Know, love, that you too will regret

lines.cyr: за наш'та љубов голема.
lines.lat: za naš'ta ljubov golema.
lines.en: our great love.

lines.cyr: Знај, мило либе, доцно ќе биде,
lines.lat: Znaj, milo libe, docno ḱe bide,
lines.en: Know, dear love, it will be late,

lines.cyr: љубовта наша помина.
lines.lat: ljubovta naša pomina.
lines.en: our love has passed.

lines.cyr: Оф либе ле, срцето ми го изгоре,
lines.lat: Of libe le, srceto mi go izgore,
lines.en: Oh love, my heart you burned,

lines.cyr: оф либе ле, мене ме млада разболе.
lines.lat: of libe le, mene me mlada razbole.
lines.en: oh love, young as I am you made me ill.
